propositions: close gate does not hard-fail when a bug is closed as duplicate without a recorded duplicates or supersedes link, falling through instead to LLM completion verifier which then fails opaquely without naming the required rebar link command
close gate must require the existence of a duplicates/supersedes link for bug closures marked --class duplicate, and must raise CommandError naming the exact rebar link command before any LLM call
close gate must accept a duplicates link targeting a closed canonical ticket (link existence only; target need not be open)
close gate must distinguish a duplicates link naming a dead/archived/unresolvable target from having no link recorded at all, emitting different error messages for each

close gate hard-fail for missing duplicates link must apply only to --class duplicate, leaving --class not_a_bug, --class escalated, and non-disposition classes unchanged with prior fallthrough behavior
hard-fail check must execute after --force early return and after bug_close_class_ok validation, preserving existing guard order and allowing --force to bypass the new check
